description: Found by the round-2 audit of bedrock-q67.26 (PR #285). FDB's ReadYourWrites drops empty/degenerate conflict ranges before they reach the resolver (RYW ~1975 and ~2490). Bedrock does not: the audit showed a {"m","m"} write-conflict range committed into history, after which a transaction that read {"a","z"} at an older version was aborted, though no key was written. Fix at the same place #285 validates conflict sections at commit ingress (Finalization): drop ranges where start >= end (exclusive end) from both sections before they are recorded or checked; pin with a test that a degenerate write range aborts nobody. Pre-existing and unrelated to the keyspace boundary.
title: Resolver does not drop empty conflict ranges: a degenerate {k, k} write conflict in history aborts every reader whose range covers k
